scope: Selected employer-verified university vacancies grouped by role. This is not an exhaustive listing of jobs.ac.uk.

jobs.title: IT Support Analyst
jobs.location: LCF – East Bank Stratford, London, UK
jobs.role_type: Permanent; 35 hours per week; on-site
jobs.summary: Provide second-line desktop, laptop and enterprise-system support, resolve escalated incidents and contribute to software deployments and service improvements.
jobs.eligibility: Experience in second-line support, Windows and macOS, AV, network services and ITIL-style processes is requested. A satisfactory Basic DBS check is required. The role requires on-site attendance.
jobs.editor_note: The current employer advert and application portal show 11 November; some search listings still show 16 November. Follow the employer’s deadline.

jobs.title: Technician in Creative Media Practice
jobs.role_type: Full time; fixed term for 12 months
jobs.summary: Maintain and support film, photography, audio and digital-media facilities for practical teaching, research and engagement projects.
jobs.eligibility: Advert requests hands-on creative-media production experience, experience supporting staff and students using media technology, and strong communication and organisation.

jobs.title: Operations Administrator
jobs.role_type: Permanent; full time; 35 hours per week
jobs.summary: Carry out finance and HR administration for the Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry, coordinating with institute, faculty and central-service colleagues.
jobs.eligibility: Significant administration experience, including accounts administration, is essential; research or clinical-environment experience is desirable.

jobs.title: Botanical Research Technician
jobs.location: Newcastle, GB; work at Nafferton and Cockle Park farms
jobs.role_type: Part time; fixed term for 20 months
jobs.salary: £30,180, progressing to £31,861 per annum, pro rata
jobs.summary: Support botanical field research by maintaining experimental plots and equipment, assisting crop assessments and helping students work safely at university farms.
jobs.eligibility: Relevant technical or research-support experience, botanical or horticultural knowledge, a relevant HNC/HND or equivalent experience, and a full UK driving licence are essential.

jobs.title: IT Support Manager (Specialist)
jobs.location: Bath; exact work site not specified in official advert
jobs.role_type: Full time, 36.5 hours per week; fixed term until 2 August 2027
jobs.summary: Lead a small second-line support team handling specialist computers, software and equipment for university teaching, research and administration.
jobs.eligibility: Advert seeks previous line management experience, IT or AV support skills, service-management knowledge and familiarity with multiple operating systems. Right-to-work requirements are assessed at offer stage; sponsorship is not guaranteed.

jobs.title: Electronics Workshop Technician
jobs.role_type: Full time; 35 hours per week; ongoing
jobs.summary: Help research and teaching teams across eight schools by designing, building and programming electronic equipment and providing workshop support.
jobs.eligibility: The advert seeks an experienced electronics technician and states that the role is unsuitable for first-time Skilled Worker visa applicants.

jobs.title: Research Fellow in Energy Geostructures
jobs.role_type: Full-time, fixed-term to 31 July 2027
jobs.summary: Model heat transfer through retaining walls used as ground heat exchangers. Work with UK and Brazilian partners to improve design methods and practical guidance for energy walls.
jobs.eligibility: Relevant engineering PhD completed or submitted before starting, or equivalent research experience; thermal simulation expertise, knowledge of ground heat exchangers or energy geostructures, and a publication record.

jobs.title: Research Fellow in Structural Biology (CryoEM)
jobs.role_type: Full-time, fixed-term for 18 months
jobs.summary: Use cryo-electron microscopy and complementary experiments to study amyloid fibril structures and their effects on neuronal function, including material derived from patient samples.
jobs.eligibility: PhD completed or near completion in structural biology, biochemistry or a related field, plus extensive cryoEM experience applied to protein structure and assembly.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Fellow — Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy
jobs.role_type: Full-time, project-limited for three years from 4 August 2027
jobs.salary: £52,229–£68,184 per annum, according to qualifications and experience
jobs.summary: Coordinate clinical investigations into takotsubo cardiomyopathy within a British Heart Foundation-funded programme, working with imaging, laboratory and clinical research teams.
jobs.eligibility: Medical degree (MBChB or equivalent), full GMC registration with a UK licence, Good Clinical Practice accreditation, Foundation competencies and at least Internal Medicine Training-level clinical experience.

jobs.title: Research Associate in Organic Synthesis
jobs.location: Manchester Institute of Biotechnology, Manchester, United Kingdom
jobs.role_type: Full-time, fixed-term for 12 months; planned start 1 January 2027
jobs.summary: Investigate new synthetic reactions that alter sugar molecular frameworks in the Miller group. The role includes reaction development, product characterisation and managing research outputs.
jobs.eligibility: PhD in organic chemistry focused on synthesis or methodology, with evidence of devising and troubleshooting experimental methods. Prior carbohydrate-chemistry experience is not required.

jobs.title: Research Associate in Biomedical Engineering
jobs.role_type: Full-time, on site; fixed-term for 16 months from 1 March 2027
jobs.summary: Build and evaluate a haemodialysis-device prototype with engineers and clinical collaborators. Testing will examine filtration performance and compatibility with blood.
jobs.eligibility: PhD completed or near completion in biomedical engineering or a related engineering/physical-science discipline; evidence of independent research, publications and effective communication. Device-testing and biological-fluid experience are desirable.

jobs.title: Research Associate in Modelling and Robotics
jobs.role_type: Full-time, fixed-term; expected start January/February 2027
jobs.summary: Develop and test computational models of dexterous soft robots within an ARIA-funded programme. Work combines mechanics, robot dynamics, numerical simulation and experimental checks.
jobs.eligibility: Relevant PhD or near completion, or equivalent research experience; strong computational modelling, robot dynamics and programming skills. Experience with finite-element or multiphysics software is required.

jobs.title: Lecturer — Psychology
jobs.role_type: Full time; Fixed term, three years
jobs.summary: Teach undergraduate psychology through lectures, seminars and tutorials. The appointment also covers teaching materials, dissertation supervision, assessment, student advice and teaching administration.
jobs.eligibility: Experience delivering effective teaching, evidence of inclusive teaching and student engagement; ability to teach mixed methods is preferred. Full criteria are in the employer's person specification.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Exercise Physiology
jobs.role_type: Full time; Ongoing
jobs.summary: Lead an exercise-physiology research programme alongside teaching, doctoral supervision and academic leadership. Research connecting exercise responses with healthy ageing, prevention, treatment or rehabilitation is particularly relevant.
jobs.eligibility: PhD in exercise or human physiology or a related field; international research standing, sustained funding and publications, substantial teaching and supervision experience, and academic leadership.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Electronic and Electrical Engineering (T&R) (1 post)
jobs.role_type: Full time (100%); Ongoing
jobs.summary: Develop power-electronics research and teach electrical and electronic engineering. Research priorities include inverter-based generation, converter control and the stability of electricity networks with extensive power electronics.
jobs.eligibility: Relevant PhD, power-electronics expertise, research outputs and funding potential, university teaching and student support experience. Previous applicants need additional relevant evidence for a new application.

jobs.title: Lecturer Academic Support
jobs.location: East Bank, Stratford, London, United Kingdom; flexible hybrid working
jobs.role_type: Part time, 22.2 hours per week; Permanent
jobs.summary: Develop academic-support learning activities with course teams and students. The post focuses on study skills, confidence, participation and progression across a diverse creative-education community.
jobs.eligibility: Extensive higher-education experience, understanding of creative students' learning needs and current teaching practice, and a commitment to inclusive learning development.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Urban Planning (Fixed-term maternity cover)
jobs.role_type: Full time (1 FTE); Fixed term, six months (January–July 2027)
jobs.summary: Teach planning and environmental management, supervise student dissertations and contribute to assessment. The maternity-cover appointment includes campus teaching and a real-estate research field class in Portugal.
jobs.eligibility: Relevant PhD; previous university teaching and supervision in urban planning; evidence of research-informed teaching and effective communication.
jobs.closing_time: Midnight, as stated by the employer

jobs.title: Lecturer in Space and Planetary Science
jobs.role_type: Full time; Fixed term, 24 months
jobs.summary: Combine undergraduate physics and space-science teaching with independent research. The department particularly welcomes expertise in spacecraft operations and design, space exploration or the use of space.
jobs.eligibility: Relevant PhD completed or submitted by interview, or equivalent qualification/experience; relevant university teaching; space-science expertise and an emerging research publication record.

jobs.title: Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Law (Teaching Track)
jobs.role_type: Full time
jobs.summary: Teach core and optional undergraduate law modules and support programme administration. The school seeks strong legal teaching, with contributions to clinical education, legal skills or employability particularly relevant.
jobs.eligibility: Law teaching experience and strong communication and administration skills. The Lecturer B profile requires a degree or equivalent professional qualification and a higher-education teaching qualification; a PhD is desirable.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Entrepreneurship
jobs.role_type: Full time; Permanent / open ended
jobs.summary: An education-focused appointment covering entrepreneurship, especially entrepreneurial finance. Responsibilities include leading modules, improving curricula and teaching financial planning, funding choices and investment-related topics.
jobs.eligibility: Ability to teach entrepreneurial finance effectively, with demonstrated classroom practice across different class sizes. Full requirements are in the employer's linked person specification.

jobs.title: Lecturer or Senior Lecturer in AI-augmented Software Engineering
jobs.role_type: Full-time, permanent
jobs.summary: Teach and conduct research on how AI can support software engineering. The appointment includes developing software-engineering teaching, pursuing external funding and collaborating across computing research groups.
jobs.eligibility: The advert calls for research and teaching capability in AI-augmented software engineering. Applicants must submit an academic CV, a one-page research plan and a one-page teaching statement.
jobs.editor_note: The employer advert gives 8 January 2027. A different date appears in the jobs.ac.uk header; the employer’s date is used here.
